scope: Review and validate the pending LibreCAD MLINE style-timing patch for same-name style-handle mismatches before integrating it into the consumer.

finding.failurePath: The first patch revision compared styleHandle with the cached MLINESTYLE handle only when late-style placeholders were supplied. If a same-named style was already cached when an MLINE callback arrived, the ordinary projection path could use that style despite a different nonzero source handle. The queue predicate also did not classify a cached handle mismatch as unresolved.
finding.impact: The displayed decomposed lines could use offsets from a style that the MLINE did not reference.
finding.evidence: Code-path review identified both late OBJECTS callbacks and a cached-style direct projection path. The added ASCII out-of-order-section regression reproduces the cached-style path with a nonzero mismatched source handle.

change.queuePredicate: When deferred import is active, a cached same-name style with a different nonzero, non-NoHandle source handle now enters the pending queue along with missing or cardinality-mismatched styles.
change.projectionGuard: The style-handle equality check now applies whenever projection considers a cached style, both for direct callbacks and deferred placeholders.
change.cachedStyleRegression: The filter regression now moves the MLINESTYLE OBJECTS section before ENTITIES in an ASCII DXF, so the style is cached before the MLINE callback. A different nonzero source handle must produce fallback offsets. The existing late-style test covers matched, missing and wrong-handle styles in ASCII and Binary DXF.
change.testEmitter: The direct DXF MLINE test emitter now writes the MLINESTYLE object referenced by each MLINE, satisfying the current strict writer contract and keeping the pre-existing writer cases valid.

validation.head: PASS: both patches apply sequentially to a fresh archive of LibreCAD 078aac892287; the resulting MLINE source files match the isolated build tree.
validation.worktree: The shared LibreCAD checkout was not modified; all patch application and builds ran under /private/tmp.
validation.applicationBuild: PASS: macOS ARM64 librecad_lib and librecad app targets build with current upstream libdxfrw sources overlaid in the isolated LibreCAD archive.
validation.focusedMlineTests: PASS: isolated mline_tests.cpp target; [mline] selector passes 596 assertions in 9 test cases, including the eager cached-style mismatch case and the ASCII/Binary deferred-style profiles.
validation.fullConsumerTests: BLOCKED BY API DIVERGENCE: librecad_tests does not compile against current upstream libdxfrw because LibreCAD tests reference fork-only dwgR inspection APIs and contain unrelated narrowing errors. librecad_dxf_fast_tests also fails before test execution: FailingDxfWriter overrides writeString(int, std::string) while upstream now requires std::string_view, and two OSNAP reference initializers narrow integers to bool. A separate bundled-fork attempt fails earlier on four associative-prefix enum values missing from that fork.
validation.fixtures: No DWG/DXF fixture files were added to the repository; generated DXFs use QTemporaryDir or existing temporary paths.

remaining: Check unrelated-record handling and output-budget disposition in a complete consumer build using a consistent library/API revision; the full test target remains open until the fork/upstream API mismatch is resolved.
Keep native GUI qualification waiting for an active display; this review does not promote consumer or DWG support.
